payload.name: Retrieve Activities Besides a Named Activity
payload.description: Use when a question asks what sports, hobbies, or activities a person likes/does besides, other than, in addition to, or apart from a named activity.
content: After the first search, run at least one follow-up query that omits the named activity and uses enjoyment/recreation terms such as 'enjoys', 'loves', 'fun', 'recreation', 'summer', or 'with friends'.

Include event memories and preference/state memory kinds; the additional activity may be stored as an indirectly phrased experience (e.g., 'had an awesome time surfing') rather than an explicit hobby list.
If top results still only mention the named activity, treat this as over-anchoring and run another query probing the person's other leisure activities before answering.
Stop after two or three distinct searches once a different activity is found or no new distinct activities appear.

solves: This fixes retrieval failures for questions asking what activities or sports a person likes besides/other than a named one, where searches stay over-anchored on the named activity and miss indirectly-phrased recreational memories.
